set.body:
Phase A (P0 correctness hotfix, no public shape change).

Problem — MISSED BY THE EXTERNAL REVIEW, which classified ClusterName as merely decorative. It is an active hang.

managed/ControlTransition.scala:735 (activeBound) selects candidates via requested.contains using STORED refs, so candidates are found. But :426 keys byJob on observationJob(value) — the OBSERVATION's ref — which cli/SlurmParsers.scala:139 has just rewritten:

    job = matched.copy(cluster = reportedCluster.orElse(matched.cluster)),

The lookup at :428 then compares a stored cluster = None against an observed cluster = Some("alpha"), misses, and the observation is discarded with no diagnostic.

Reachability on an ordinary site: sbatch --parsable returns a bare job id with no ;cluster suffix unless federated (SlurmParsers.scala:43-44), while squeue v0.0.43 JSON does emit "cluster" (fixtures/slurm-v0.0.43/squeue-pending.json:9). So the stored ref and every observed ref disagree, every managed observation is dropped, and no attempt ever advances.

Same failure class as the BOOT_FAIL hang in P8.A2.

Fix:
- Normalize cluster out of the observation-matching key in ControlTransition (byJob/activeBound) and SlurmCliScheduler.identity (:242).
- Emit a diagnostic when a reported cluster differs from a stored one, rather than silently dropping the row.
- Semantics only. The structural fix (single-cluster operational identity) is P8.D4.

Acceptance:
- Test: stored ref cluster = None + squeue JSON "cluster": "alpha" => observation applied to the attempt. Demonstrated RED against the parent commit.
set.title: P8.A1: Stop dropping every observation on cluster mismatch
